name: JF Video Autoplay
description: Displays a hero banner on the home page with auto-playing trailers, logos, and quick details.

versions.changelog: EXPERIMENTAL VideoAutoplay 1.1.2 RC2. Updated for Jellyfin Server 12.0 and .NET 10 while retaining the SPA remount, authenticated-client resolution, and yt-direct fallback fixes from RC1. Live testing requested. Stable production release remains v1.0.0.

EXPERIMENTAL VideoAutoplay 1.1.2 RC1. SPA dependency readiness and remount recovery, duplicate runtime suppression, invalid_executable iframe fallback and negative caching. Live testing requested. Stable production release remains v1.0.0.

Fixed delayed or stale artwork and trailer updates, added revision-aware automatic and manual media refresh, fixed the RC1 media-cache loader regression, enforced deterministic versioned dependency loading, upgraded legacy injection tags without duplication, and preserved authenticated frontend access without shared API keys.

Upgraded to Jellyfin 10.11.x and .NET 9. Removed the shared API key and switched frontend requests to the authenticated Jellyfin session. Secured administrative endpoints, file-path handling, index injection, and yt-dlp execution. Fixed autoplay settings, stale trailer rendering, empty tabs, resource cleanup, thumbnail navigation, and duplicate configuration handlers. Added local HLS.js, reproducible packaging, and automated tests.

- Initial release
- Autoplay hero section
- Supports YouTube / Vimeo / direct video
